prompt: 考試剩十分鐘，作文還沒寫。哪一句最像考生合理的自我提醒？
options: I should write a short outline first.
I will read the whole test again.
I can leave the essay blank.
answer: I should write a short outline first.

時間不夠，重讀整份考卷會讓作文更沒時間寫。
留白會失去作文的分數，應盡量寫出內容。

why: 時間有限時，先簡短列綱要能保證結構完整，再開始寫。
tip: 時間不足：先列綱要再動筆。
say: I should write a short outline first.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: I have finished the reading part.
I have finish the reading part.
I finished already the reading part.
answer: I have finished the reading part.

現在完成式要用 have + 過去分詞 finished。
already 的位置不自然，應放在 have 與過去分詞之間或句尾。

why: 現在完成式 have + p.p. 表示已完成。
say: I have finished the reading part.

text: Don't spend too much time _____ a single question.
options: on
at
for

wrong.at: at 通常指地點或時間點，spend time on 才是固定搭配。
wrong.for: for 不與 spend time 連用來接事情。

why: spend time on 是固定搭配。
tip: 時間花在某事：spend time on。
say: Don't spend too much time on a single question.

prompt: Skip the question and come back later. 最合適的意思是？
text: Skip the question and come back later.
options: 先跳過這題，之後再回來做
把題目抄下來
立刻放棄整份考卷
answer: 先跳過這題，之後再回來做

wrong.立刻放棄整份考卷: 只跳過一題，且說 come back later，並未放棄。

why: skip 是略過，come back later 表示之後回來處理。
tip: 卡關先跳過，標記後再回頭。
say: Skip the question and come back later.

prompt: 你想說：我常因粗心把答案畫錯格。哪一句最自然？
options: I often mark the answer in the wrong box by mistake.
I often mark the answer wrong box by mistake.
I often mark answer at wrong box with mistake.
answer: I often mark the answer in the wrong box by mistake.

wrong.I often mark the answer wrong box by mis: 缺少介系詞 in，wrong box 不能直接接在 answer 後面。
wrong.I often mark answer at wrong box with mi: by mistake 才是固定片語，with mistake 不通；也缺少冠詞。

why: in the wrong box 是位置，by mistake 表示不小心。
say: I often mark the answer in the wrong box by mistake.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: There are only twenty minutes left.
There is only twenty minutes left.
It has only twenty minutes left.
answer: There are only twenty minutes left.

minutes 是複數，be 動詞要用 are。
時間剩餘要用 There be 或 We have，It has 的主詞不明。

why: There be + 複數名詞，be 動詞跟著後面的名詞，所以用 are。
tip: There be 看後面名詞單複數。
say: There are only twenty minutes left.

text: I will check my spelling _____ I finish the essay.
options: after
unless
although

wrong.unless: unless 是除非，語意變成不完成作文就不檢查，不合邏輯。
wrong.although: although 表示轉折，這裡是時間先後。

why: 完成作文之後再檢查，用時間連接詞 after。
say: I will check my spelling after I finish the essay.

prompt: The question is a pitfall for careless readers. 最接近的意思？
text: The question is a pitfall for careless readers.
options: 這題對粗心的讀者是個陷阱
這題很簡單
這題是閱讀範例
answer: 這題對粗心的讀者是個陷阱

wrong.這題很簡單: pitfall 是陷阱或隱藏的難處，並不是簡單。
wrong.這題是閱讀範例: 句子沒有說這是範例題，而是提醒容易犯錯。

why: pitfall 指容易掉進去的陷阱，careless 說明容易出錯的人。
say: The question is a pitfall for careless readers.

prompt: 同學問：為什麼作文要留五分鐘檢查？哪個回答最合理？
options: Because we can find small mistakes in grammar and spelling.
Because the paper will become longer.
Because teachers like quiet students.
answer: Because we can find small mistakes in grammar and spelling.

檢查不是為了增加字數，而是修正錯誤。
與批改內容無關，不是檢查的理由。

why: 檢查能抓到文法、拼字等小錯，讓成績更穩。
say: We can find small mistakes in grammar and spelling.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Make the most of your time.
Make most of your time.
Make the most from your time.
answer: Make the most of your time.

固定片語是 make the most of，the 不能省略。
介系詞是 of，不是 from。

why: make the most of 表示充分利用。
tip: 充分利用：make the most of。
say: Make the most of your time.

text: Please read the instructions _____ you begin.
options: before
since
while

wrong.since: since 表示自從，或因為，不適合表達開始前先讀。
wrong.while: while 表示同時，但指示應該在開始作答之前讀。

why: before 表示在……之前，符合先讀題再作答。
say: Please read the instructions before you begin.
